body:
Real finding: no email/password signup HTML exists anywhere -- register.go's API has zero frontend, portal.go is login-only, WOTAN's tournaments.html signup is email-only. IDUNA_PRO has no static-file serving. Real 2-phase plan (decide hosting, build the form). Scoped, not swallowed whole. Commit af7ef0b.

⚓ ☃
title: Scoped WOTAN signup UI (kanban WOTAN-997), applying new Principle 19
